protocol: Booking load, cold addresses, 120 s at 1 and 5 desks; the database container waterflex-scheduler-java-scheduler-db-1 paused for 0,300,1000 ms every 10 s, one arm per length (0 is the baseline).
hypothesis: A pause shorter than the Hikari connection-timeout (250 ms) costs latency only; a longer one turns searches that need a connection during it into 429 BUSY (refused at admission or at publish) without 500s.
